title: Threshold implementations with $t+1$ shares for APN permutations
summary: Determine whether any APN permutation of algebraic degree $t$ admits a $t+1$-share threshold implementation.

formal_statement.body: Let $F$ be an APN permutation of algebraic degree $t$ over a binary field. Decide whether there exists a threshold implementation of $F$ with exactly $t+1$ shares satisfying correctness, non-completeness, and uniformity in the source model. Prove nonexistence for every such APN permutation, or exhibit and verify a counterexample.

scope.domain: APN permutation S-boxes and their side-channel threshold implementations
assumptions: Threshold implementation uses the source correctness, non-completeness, and uniformity requirements
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later result proves or refutes the universal APN $t+1$-share threshold-implementation conjecture.

progress.summary: The source states that no APN permutation of degree $t$ admits a threshold implementation with $t+1$ shares.
